study: Physics-injection grid: family x target x mechanism under the unified protocol of 10.42, over 5 seeds.

protocol.excluded_cell: state x hard (an output projection, not a shell)

verdict.reading: 17 cells of the target x mechanism x family grid were trained under one protocol. The best multi-start drift is 76.3 px (DeepONet/residual/soft) and the worst is 444.7 px (DeepONet/state/soft). The hard shell moves drift the way the 10.42 account predicts for ['MLP', 'DeepONet', 'FNO'] and the opposite way for no family, so the shell's effect on prediction is uniform in sign across the families that completed.
